title: Nutty Yeasty Vietnamese Doner Meat Pho Ga
description: A yeasty, aerated Vietnamese dish featuring doner meat, served in a pho ga style with a twist of double fry KFC and low glycemic friendly ingredients, presented on a cedar plank.
instructions: Soak the cedar plank in water for at least 30 minutes before cooking.
In a large bowl, combine yeast, fish sauce, lime juice, ginger, and garlic, and mix well.
Add the sliced doner meat to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and double fry the marinated doner meat until crispy and golden brown.
In a large pot, combine chicken broth, star anise, and cooked rice noodles, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the noodles and broth on the soaked cedar plank, then top with double fried doner meat and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
Discard the star anise before serving.
Cook the doner meat to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit to ensure food safety.
